diff --git a/internal/config/tracing_test.go b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1c86c99
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaultsAndLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	defaults := Default().Tracing
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), defaults.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, defaults.Propagators)
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, xray]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorXRay}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestTracingValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		require.NoError(t, (&TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}).validate())
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN()} {
+		require.EqualError(t, (&TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}).validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	options := []TracingPropagator{
+		TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage, TracingPropagatorB3,
+		TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+		TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, (&TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: options}).validate())
+	require.EqualError(t, (&TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: []TracingPropagator{"unknown"}}).validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestTracingLoadValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name, tracing, want string
+	}{
+		{"negative ratio", "samplingRatio: -0.1", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"ratio above one", "samplingRatio: 1.1", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"invalid propagator", "propagators: [tracecontext, unknown]", "invalid propagator option: unknown"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  "+tt.tracing+"\n"), 0600))
+			_, err := Load(path)
+			require.EqualError(t, err, tt.want)
+		})
+	}
+}

+// NewPropagator combines the configured context propagation formats.
+func NewPropagator(cfg *config.TracingConfig) propagation.TextMapPropagator {
+	var propagators []propagation.TextMapPropagator
+	for _, option := range cfg.Propagators {
+		switch option {
+		case config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.TraceContext{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorBaggage:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.Baggage{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3SingleHeader)))

+		case config.TracingPropagatorJaeger:

+		case config.TracingPropagatorXRay:
